S081.name: Stress_Related_Maladaptive_Response
S081.description: Emotional or behavioral symptoms appearing in response to an identifiable stressor.

subtypes.With Depressed Mood: Symptoms mainly include low mood, tearfulness, or feelings of hopelessness.
subtypes.With Anxiety: Symptoms mainly include nervousness, worry, jitteriness, or separation anxiety.
subtypes.With Mixed Anxiety and Depressed Mood: A combination of depression and anxiety symptoms appears.
subtypes.With Disturbance of Conduct: Symptoms mainly involve violation of rules, truancy, vandalism, reckless driving, or fighting.
subtypes.With Mixed Disturbance of Emotions and C: Both emotional symptoms (depression, anxiety) and behavioral problems appear together.
subtypes.Unspecified: Maladaptive reactions not classified into the above types (e.g., physical complaints, social withdrawal).

patient_info.stressor_event: Revision of personal habits (dress, manners, associations, quitting smoking)
patient_info.stressor: Toni made a deliberate overhaul of her daily habits after deciding she needed to be taken more seriously in local arts administration, cutting back on late-night shows, changing how she presented herself at community events, and distancing herself from the casual social circle that had filled most evenings. The change was meant to be temporary and goal-oriented, but over two months her reaction to the self-imposed reset began disrupting the volunteer and creative roles that usually gave her life structure. She still managed basic responsibilities, but she missed planning details for the summer fair, canceled several board-game nights, and lost momentum on photography and design tasks she had promised to deliver. Worried that the pattern was becoming bigger than the lifestyle change itself, she contacted a sliding-scale community mental health clinic for an intake appointment.

S081.name: Stress_Related_Maladaptive_Response
S081.description: Emotional or behavioral symptoms appearing in response to an identifiable stressor.
S081.manifestation: I came in because since I tried to clean up my image and routine for the arts board stuff, I’ve been more tense and down than I expected, like I’m still doing the basics but I keep dropping little things I normally care about, like fair planning notes or design drafts, and then I feel guilty and cancel plans instead of catching up.

additional_requirement_1.name: Additional Requirement 1
additional_requirement_1.description: Symptoms must develop within 3 months of the onset of the stressor
additional_requirement_1.manifestation: I started feeling this way a few weeks after I began changing my clothes, routines, and who I was spending time with for the arts board image reset.

additional_requirement_2.name: Additional Requirement 2
additional_requirement_2.description: Within 6 months of the termination of the stressor or its consequences
additional_requirement_2.manifestation: The whole reset is still going on, so this has not been some separate problem continuing long after the changes ended.

functional_impairment.name: Functional Impairment
functional_impairment.manifestation: I am still getting through basic errands and commitments, but I have been less reliable in the volunteer and creative roles people usually count on me for, like fair planning and design follow-through.

duration.name: Duration
duration.manifestation: This has been going on for about two months, since I started trying to overhaul my routine and presentation.
